SELECT board_data.*, COALESCE(heart_counts.heart_count, 0) AS heart_count FROM ( SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, IFNULL(COP.C_NAME, '새회사') AS C_NAME FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N'
AND ( BRD.B_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR BRD.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY BRD.B_IDX DESC LIMIT #{page} OFFSET #{offset} ) board_data LEFT JOIN ( SELECT H_B_IDX, COUNT(*) as heart_count FROM HEART GROUP BY H_B_IDX ) heart_counts ON board_data.B_IDX = heart_counts.H_B_IDX

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BRD.B_IDX) FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N'
AND ( BRD.B_TITLE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR BRD.B_CONTENT LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_U_IDX AS B_U_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_MODIFY AS B_MODIFY, BRD.B_VOTE AS B_VOTE, BRD.B_DELETE AS B_DELETE, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, IFNULL(COP.C_NAME, '새회사') AS C_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT HRT.H_IDX) AS COUNT, VT.V_IDX AS V_IDX, VT.V_TITLE AS V_TITLE FROM BOARD BRD JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON HRT.H_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX LEFT JOIN VOTE VT ON VT.V_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_IDX = #{b_idx}
SELECT IMG.I_IDX AS I_IDX, IMG.I_B_IDX AS I_B_IDX, IMG.I_IMAGE AS I_IMAGE FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN IMAGE_FILE IMG ON IMG.I_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_IDX = #{b_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ALARM (A_B_IDX, A_RECEIVER_IDX,A_SENDER_IDX, A_TYPE, A_URL) VALUES (#{a_b_idx}, #{a_receiver_idx}, #{a_sender_idx}, #{a_type}, #{a_url})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM HEART WHERE H_U_IDX = #{h_u_idx} AND H_B_IDX = #{h_b_idx}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO BOARD (B_U_IDX, B_TITLE, B_CONTENT) VALUES (#{b_u_idx}, #{b_title}, #{b_content})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS COUNT FROM HEART HRT JOIN BOARD BRD ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX WHERE B_IDX = #{b_idx}

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, COUNT(DISTINCT HRT.H_IDX) AS LIKE_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT COM.CM_IDX) AS COMMENT_COUNT, COUNT(I_IDX) AS IMAGE_COUNT FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX AND HRT.H_IDX IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN COMMENT COM ON BRD.B_IDX = COM.CM_B_IDX LEFT JOIN IMAGE_FILE IMG ON BRD.B_IDX = IMG.I_B_IDX WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' AND BRD.B_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) GROUP BY BRD.B_IDX ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, BRD.B_DATE DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, BRD.B_CONTENT AS B_CONTENT, BRD.B_DATE AS B_DATE, BRD.B_HITS AS B_HITS, COUNT(HRT.H_IDX) AS LIKE_COUNT, COUNT(DISTINCT COM.CM_IDX) AS COMMENT_COUNT, COUNT(I_IDX) AS IMAGE_COUNT FROM BOARD BRD LEFT JOIN HEART HRT ON BRD.B_IDX = HRT.H_B_IDX LEFT JOIN COMMENT COM ON BRD.B_IDX = COM.CM_B_IDX LEFT JOIN IMAGE_FILE IMG ON BRD.B_IDX = IMG.I_B_IDX AND HRT.H_IDX IS NOT NULL WHERE BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' AND BRD.B_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY BRD.B_IDX ORDER BY LIKE_COUNT DESC, BRD.B_DATE DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT VO.VO_IDX AS VO_IDX, VO.VO_CONTENT AS VO_CONTENT, VO.VO_COUNT AS VO_COUNT FROM VOTE VT JOIN VOTE_OPTION VO ON VT.V_IDX = VO.VO_V_IDX WHERE V_B_IDX = #{v_b_idx}

SELECT VT.V_IDX AS V_IDX, VT.V_TITLE AS V_TITLE, BRD.B_IDX AS B_IDX, BRD.B_TITLE AS B_TITLE, IFNULL(COP.C_NAME, '새회사') AS C_NAME, USR.U_IDX AS U_IDX, USR.U_NICNAME AS U_NICNAME, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM VOTE_RESULT VR JOIN VOTE_OPTION VO ON VR.VR_VO_IDX = VO.VO_IDX WHERE VO.VO_V_IDX = VT.V_IDX ) AS VOTE_PARTICIPANTS, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM Heart HRT WHERE HRT.H_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX ) AS LIKE_COUNT, ( SELECT COUNT(1) FROM COMMENT COM WHERE COM.CM_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX ) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM VOTE VT JOIN BOARD BRD ON VT.V_B_IDX = BRD.B_IDX JOIN USER USR ON BRD.B_U_IDX = USR.U_IDX LEFT JOIN COMPANY COP ON USR.U_C_IDX = COP.C_IDX WHERE VT.V_DATE >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND BRD.B_DELETE = 'N' AND BRD.B_VOTE = 'Y' ORDER BY ( SELECT SUM(VO.VO_COUNT) FROM VOTE_OPTION VO WHERE VO.VO_V_IDX = VT.V_IDX ) DESC LIMIT 3
